name: Fixed Basis for Time Axis
aliases: Static Feature Matrix with Time Basis
definition: A failed design that models dynamic scenes by storing a static feature matrix for each spatial point and using basis functions $f(t)$ to compute features at time $t$ via inner product.
summary: Fixed Basis for Time Axis is a failed dynamic scene representation that models temporal changes via inner products with static basis functions, distinguished by its excessive memory requirements and reconstruction artifacts.
